• Unordered, records/s at workMicros 0 / 100 / 1000: KPipe 713k / 516k / 544k, Atleon 656k / 543k / 522k, raw 1.00M / 707k / 685k.
• KPipe ÷ Atleon: 1.09x / 0.95x / 1.04x unordered, 0.85x / 1.01x / 0.94x per key. KPipe ÷ raw: 0.71x / 0.73x / 0.79x.
• gc.count and gc.time are totals for the measurement window, so faster arms run more invocations and collect more.
Per-partition arms and the single-threaded baseline are omitted: different guarantee. Full table: benchmarks/results/2026-10-22/2026-10-22-ci-parallel.md
